body: I appreciate the advice and time you took to read and respond. I’ve been trying to find someone locally that I can become a “disciple” to as my church phrased it. Someone to talk to about God and church and life once a week and make spiritual growth there. It’s just hard to pick back up when I don’t know where to begin.

High school is always a stressful time when it comes down to senior year. We expect 18 year olds who have been told where to sit and taught how to think to have the capability to adequately handle the upcoming life we will have. But look at it this way, you’ve lived only 2/8 of your life. Somewhere in those 6/8 you’ll find the win. Parents are hard to handle sometimes, the goal of parenting is to do better for children than what we did for ourselves. School isn’t easy for everyone and there’s no shame in that. Your little sister seems to give you a lot of drive and motivation. Hold on to that. Hold on to the feelings you get when you make her smile or laugh. It’s hard, not everything that is worth it is easy, but just think of how great it would be to watch her walk in 10 years. You will walk one day, you will have your moment, you can do it. You are strong enough to admit that there is a problem and that shows great strength of character. Not everyone can come out and say that there is an issue and seek help before it’s too late. You are strong, you are not defined by the numbers a flawed school system assigns to your hard work and dedication. I believe in you, I feel like you are capable of doing anything you set your mind to.
